dashboard_line: Phase 1 wired: f0+aged_score+coherence_entropy; measure-only, zero behavior change

files_modified.changes: Added compute_f0(), log_f0_to_session_metrics(); wired into assemble_bundle() post-assembly; logs to forensics/session-metrics/{date}.json
Added aged_score(); wired into build_summary() per agent; outputs aged_score, aged_score_days_since_eval, aged_score_interpretation fields
Added mission_coherence(); wired into --query topology output with HIGHLY_FOCUSED/BALANCED/FRAGMENTED assessment

implementation_notes.f0_integration_point: assemble_bundle() post-assembly; token estimate is heuristic (main_tokens=bundle.total_tokens, agent_tokens=4x heuristic); Phase 2 will wire actual API token counts
implementation_notes.aged_score_integration_point: build_summary() per agent; last_updated parsed from card frontmatter; falls back to 0.0 days if absent
implementation_notes.coherence_integration_point: --query topology only; not yet in dashboard-json or regen output
known_gaps: f0 agent_tokens estimate is 4x heuristic — actual API response token counts not yet wired
aged_score last_updated parsing requires REPUTATION block to have last_updated field — older cards without it get days_since=0 (no decay applied)
coherence metric only shows in --query topology, not in --query dashboard-json or --dashboard html yet
